capabilities: Generate CSS snippets from settings dialogs
Configure custom task checkboxes with colors and styling
Preview checkbox appearance in light and dark modes
Enable generated snippets via Appearance settings
extras: README notes some themes conflict with generated snippets and directs users to the #appearance Discord channel or GitHub issues for troubleshooting; beta installation via BRAT is described.
problem: Writing CSS snippets by hand to customize task checkboxes or folder appearance is difficult for users who don't know CSS.

relations.evidence: My Snippets to view/toggle your snippets from the status bar
Task Collector to mark your tasks with a few keystrokes
Style Settings for the color picker and dynamic style setting
Fantasy Calendar as a plugin with complicated modal settings

summary: GUI-based generator that creates CSS snippets, such as custom task checkboxes and colored folders, through configuration dialogs.
